notes: Six-band mundane Adornment pathway. Replaceable fittings add physical protection or visible field marking to ordinary gear; no rune, relic, magic amplification, passive statistic, or quest-only component is specified. Band 2 is an alternate Thornfell production route to the same functional field fitting, avoiding a shallow extra item.

items.description: A replaceable clasp and tie set that secures loose straps on ordinary field gear.
items.purpose: A common Adornment attachment with two regional material routes and later upgrades.

external_uses.detail: Fitted or replaced on ordinary field gear to keep straps and small tools secure.

items.notes: Physical attachment only; later recipes consume the fitting when rebuilt into a more specialized version.

items.description: A field fitting with a sealed stormwood face that sheds ordinary rain and grime from a gear joint.
items.purpose: Uses Woodcutting and Alchemy materials to make a practical gear-protection attachment with two later upgrade paths.

external_uses.detail: Fitted or replaced where exposed straps or gear joints need ordinary weather protection.

items.notes: Stormwood's durability and flexibility are canon; the seal is a mundane fish-oil and shell-powder treatment.

items.description: A cleaned conduit sleeve and bracket added to a weatherproof fitting for gear kept near hot forge work.
items.purpose: Provides a physical Emberholt specialization and a direct input to the Ashsteel master upgrade.

external_uses.detail: Fitted or replaced on practical forge-side field gear exposed to ordinary heat and abrasion.

items.notes: Cleaned conduit is used as salvage metal, not as a magical conductor.

items.description: A weatherproof clasp coated with a pale marking paste so its position can be seen against dark gear.
items.purpose: A distinct Mire visibility branch and a meaningful late sink for lantern-moss Alchemy paste.

external_uses.detail: Fitted or replaced on dark field gear so the clasp's location remains visibly marked.

items.notes: The paste does not glow, emit light, reveal hidden objects, or carry a memory effect.

items.description: An Ashsteel-backed rebuild of a heatproof field fitting for heavily worn forge-side gear.
items.purpose: A compact high-mastery Adornment endpoint with connected early fittings, salvage, leather, and Ashsteel inputs.

external_uses.detail: Fitted or replaced on heavily used field gear near Emberholt forge work.

items.notes: Ashsteel is canon; no increased combat power, resonance, or active rune behavior is inferred.

recipes.description: Set common forged pins through cured leather to hold a small field-gear strap securely.
recipes.purpose: Starts Adornment through already available Smithing and Leatherworking materials.
recipes.notes: The clasp is an ordinary replaceable fitting, not an enchanted item.

recipes.description: Tie the same functional field clasp with sinew cord and ridge wool rather than a broad leather tab.
recipes.purpose: Adds a justified Thornfell sourcing route to the same common fitting without a redundant output item.
recipes.notes: Ridge wool is unlocked in band 2; no late component blocks this recipe.

recipes.description: Rebuild a field clasp around stormwood and treat its joint with rendered fish oil and silt-shell powder.
recipes.purpose: Connects early fittings to Woodcutting, Angling, and Alchemy in a persistent weatherproof gear branch.
recipes.notes: Shell powder is first processed in band 3; this recipe cannot be unlocked before it.

recipes.description: Brace a weatherproof clasp with cleaned conduit metal and an ordinary industrial mount.
recipes.purpose: Links Adornment to Emberholt's salvage and Mechanisms without implying conduit magic.
recipes.notes: The recovered conduit and its mount are both available in band 4.

recipes.description: Mark a weatherproof clasp with lantern-moss paste for visible placement on dark gear.
recipes.purpose: Creates a distinct Mire field-visibility specialization and late Alchemy paste sink.
recipes.notes: Lantern-moss paste first exists in band 5. The fitting is a painted visual marker, not a light source.

recipes.description: Rebuild a heatproof clasp around a shaped Ashsteel backing and a fresh leather tie.
recipes.purpose: Carries early fittings forward to an Ashsteel-connected master endpoint without quest materials.
recipes.notes: Ashsteel bar production begins in band 5, so it is available before this band 6 recipe.
